decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is used).
Condition : 4 - The extension [building] hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 32 Orchard Road.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of  8am to 6pm on Mondays to Friday and 9am to 1pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the eastern wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 8 - With respect to demolition and construction works, the loading and unloading, and parking of vehicles, shall be provided within the curtilage of the site."
Condition : 9 - With respect to demolition and construction works, the loading and unloading, and parking of vehicles, shall be provided within the curtilage of the site

Condition : 10 - INFORMATIVE:  This planning permission relates to Job No PP/2011 Dwg Nos A-01 and A-02, received 5 February 2004, showing that there is no change to the number of bedrooms (i.e. two) so that the parking requirement remains one car.
description: Erection of a two storey side and part single storey rear extension to dwellinghouse.
